description: inversion_count mod.rs: original algorithm and independent finite correspondence
cost: O(n log n) comparisons, two O(n) usize buffers and O(log n) recursion depth. Word arithmetic exact under cap; generic Ord comparison cost is not assumed constant in wall time.
forward: Return I(x)=sum over i<j of indicator(x[i]>x[j]). Recursively sort index halves, merge stably by <=; when the right index wins add the number of unconsumed left indices. Original values remain borrowed and never cloned or written.
inverse: Typed behavior complement and ambiguous reverse reconstruction in model.md
limitations: Finite tests are not a proof; allocation refusal not injected; macros opaque and semantic AST absent
